infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sanket uses your camera only when you choose to scan a Nearby pairing QR code or sign in Indian Sign Language.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sanket uses your microphone only when you tap Speak to transcribe speech for your conversation partner.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Sanket to access your camera for QR pairing and Indian Sign Language input.
